question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

XBF 84 IMQ 92 TXB 100 EIM 108 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c8be81ca7d13139490554e4613a48f71e9f5a4c47bfe4e0802be01fd3a37065.png] 

Logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/112469d039b557877808a762b24ef4889a8f35839ae2e3d0f1408d6c59049c02.png] 

 

The pattern observed is: (Letter + 11) and (Number + 8).

Therefore, the code for the question mark (?) is **PTX 116**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
